item.title: Episode 3 – Artificial intelligence: a conference for the teachers of lycée Jeanne d’Arc
item.author: vincent.loiseau@sustainablemind.tech (Vincent Loiseau)
item.description: A keynote for 70 teachers at lycée Jeanne d’Arc explored the fundamentals, benefits, and environmental and ethical challenges of artificial intelligence in education.
